translations.web: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”
translations.bsb: Am I in need of madmen, that you have brought this man to rave in my presence? Must this man come into my house?”
translations.kjv: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
translations.asv: Do I lack madmen, that ye have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
